pyqgis_plugin.name: Fillet / Chamfer Tool for QGIS 3.x & Batch Fillet / Chamfer Tool for 3.x and 4.x
pyqgis_plugin.description: Interactive Fillet & Chamfer tool for QGIS 3.x and Batch Fillet / Chamfer Tool for QGIS 3.x & 4.x.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Provides interactive CAD-like Fillet (corner rounding) and Chamfer (corner beveling) digitizing for QGIS 3.x, plus an instant Batch Processing panel for selected vector features in both QGIS 3.x and QGIS 4.x.
pyqgis_plugin.tags: cad, editing, fillet, chamfer, geometry, digitizing, curve, batch, qgis4
